verdict: Strong ROAS held this period; key deliverables now need to catch up.
narrative: Your Meta ads delivered a 5.51x return on ad spend this period on $1,366.46 in spend, generating $7,525.15 in revenue from 43 purchases — and that efficiency improved another 18% over the most recent week. Purchase volume is holding steady rather than accelerating, which is the natural ceiling when several planned scaling steps are still pending. Eleven SOW milestones — covering subscription flows, site work, and Tier 3 expansion — are overdue and are the primary thing standing between current performance and the next growth phase. Those deliverables are being prioritized now so the strong ROAS has the infrastructure to scale into.
